close_reason: Made CtLogList::new and DeviationStore::new const fn, matching the precedent set by CertPool::new in pass-2. Both are trivial constructors over fields that are const-initializable (unit struct / Vec::new()). No API or behavior change.
description:
## Anchor
PKIX-qwzx (pass 2) commit message claims: 'CertPool::new is const fn with FromIterator + Extend'. The const-fn change at pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:69 was an idiom cleanup — Vec::new() is const since 1.39, so a constructor that only initializes a Vec field can be const fn.

## Finding
The same idiom applies to two other constructors that pass-2 did not touch:

1. **pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:51** — CtLogList::new
   ```
   pub fn new() -> Self { Self::default() }
   ```
   CtLogList has no fields (line 44 — comment-only struct). The body uses Self::default() because Default::default() is not const-callable in this context. Could be:
   ```
   pub const fn new() -> Self { Self {} }
   ```
   Trivial change; same shape as CertPool::new.

2. **pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:525** — DeviationStore::new
   ```
   pub fn new() -> Self { Self::default() }
   ```
   DeviationStore has one field: deviations: Vec<Deviation>. Vec::new() is const, so:
   ```
   pub const fn new() -> Self { Self { deviations: Vec::new() } }
   ```
   Mirrors CertPool::new exactly.

## Verification
`grep 'pub (const )?fn new(' pkix-*/src/*.rs` shows the inconsistency clearly:
- pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:69: pub const fn new() — done in pass-2
- pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:343: pub const fn new() — PathBuilderConfig, also done
- pkix-composite/src/lib.rs:72: pub const fn new() — done
- pkix-revocation-http/src/lib.rs:114, 145: pub const fn new() — done
- pkix-path/src/lib.rs:440: pub const fn new() — TrustAnchor, done
- pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:693: pub const fn new() — DeviationRunner, done
- pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:51: pub fn new() — MISSED
- pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:525: pub fn new() — MISSED
- pkix-path/src/lib.rs:681: pub fn new() — ValidationPolicy. Body uses ..Default::default() over a 13-field struct; making it const requires writing out all 13 field initializers. Less compelling, separate finding if anything.
- pkix-revocation/src/{crl,ocsp}.rs:127, 102: pub fn new() — body returns Result<Self>, depends on parsing, cannot be const. Correctly non-const.
- pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:610, src/report.rs:139: pub fn new() — bodies do non-const work (debug_assert, Vec::new with checks, Cow). Acceptable as non-const.

## Severity
P3 (idiom / consistency). const-fn constructors are useful for static initialization and for callers that want to embed the type in const contexts. The benefit is small but the change is mechanical and matches a precedent set by pass-2 for the same shape of constructor.

## Fix
For each of the two missed constructors:
1. Add 'const' before 'fn new'.
2. Replace Self::default() with the explicit Self { ... } literal whose fields are all const-initializable (Vec::new(), unit fields).

No API or behavior change — purely additive (const fn is a strict superset of fn for callers).
title: (IDIOM) P3: pass-2 const-fn cleanup incomplete: CtLogList::new and DeviationStore::new still non-const while CertPool::new is const
